payload.content: To extract the year, month, or day from a date column in SQLite, use `STRFTIME('%Y', col)`, `STRFTIME('%m', col)`, `STRFTIME('%d', col)`. The MySQL-style `YEAR(col)`, `MONTH(col)`, `DAY(col)` functions are NOT supported in SQLite and will raise an error.

rationale: Substitutes the SQLite-canonical date-component idiom for the MySQL idiom that pretrained models default to; pure operator substitution, fits is_.
